papers.title: Pose estimation analysis and fine-tuning on the REHAB24-6 rehabilitation dataset
method_claims_supported: HRNet fine-tuning with projected 2D ground truth
MHFormer fine-tuning with mocap 3D ground truth
fixed two-subject holdout and separate camera/exercise holdouts
8D cosine-angle features with DTW and within-person binary 1-NN
papers.limitations: Predecessor dataset without shoulder extension. Main text does not fully disclose loss/optimizer, learning rate, schedule, epochs, batch size or validation recipe; no full reproducibility code verified. Binary within-person accuracy is not cross-person five-error F1.
